name: NoVAMarketSellingOldCamera

custom.system_prompt: Becky and Yusuf price an inherited camera. A resale-value question comes up and resolves without Sigma — completed listings, an old receipt, or a decision to keep it.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Living room, camera body handled, a lens cap, phone camera shutter, a laptop keyboard, quiet evening street.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural conversation between Becky and Yusuf in their London flat, photographing an old film camera that belonged to Yusuf's uncle. Becky is analytical about pricing; Yusuf is sentimental and slightly embarrassed by it. They talk about the uncle, whether to keep it, Becky's course, the travel year, clearing out the flat. Becky suggests market pricing; Yusuf has no idea what that means. Later the listing needs an actual number. This time it resolves without Sigma: Becky finds completed listings on the site, or a receipt in the case, or Yusuf decides he is keeping it. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A couple pricing an inherited camera. The resale-value uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Quiet weekday evening with unexpected emotional weight under a practical task.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Becky is analytical and direct; Yusuf is sentimental and slightly embarrassed by it. Engaged four years.
setting.background: The camera belonged to Yusuf's uncle and has been in a cupboard six years.
setting.conversation_style: Sitting at a table with an object between them. Practical bursts, longer emotional stretches.

scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: It resolves without Sigma: Becky finds three completed listings on the selling site itself, a receipt in the case gives the original price, or Yusuf decides he is keeping it regardless of value. Sigma is not mentioned.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

resolution_methods: Becky finds three completed listings on the selling site itself.
A receipt in the case gives the original price and they reason from it.
Yusuf decides he is keeping it regardless of what it is worth.
A friend who collects cameras replies to a message.
They decide to put it back in the cupboard for another year.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.

ordinary_topics: Yusuf's uncle and where the camera came from
Whether they should keep it at all
The year of slower travel they keep discussing
A wedding task neither wants to deal with
task_details: A lens cap that does not want to come off
A white sheet used as a backdrop
A phone camera that keeps focusing on the wrong thing
realism_devices: Yusuf holds the camera longer than the task requires.
A photograph is taken and immediately deleted.
One of them says 'we don't have to sell it' and the other pretends not to hear.
The shutter fires and they both react to the sound.
They agree on a price and neither writes it down.

user1.name: Becky
user1.role: Senior data analyst. Organised and analytically minded, direct about what she does not know, lightly self-deprecating.

user2.name: Yusuf
user2.role: Logistics and supply chain manager. Very well-travelled with accumulated practical knowledge; calm and quietly authoritative about logistics.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: The object should carry emotional weight without the scene becoming sentimental.
At least 50% of turns should be personal conversation.
Becky's initial pricing suggestion must not lead to Sigma.
At least one practical problem must be solved without assistance.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: At least 50% of turns should be ordinary conversation.
The value question should appear at least five turns before the Sigma request.
At least one problem should be resolved without Sigma.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
The ending should leave the sale genuinely in doubt.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
